points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable e5d4a7a clean CMake build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench using explicit /opt/external dependencies; report compiles. Default delivered external path is unavailable in manager checkout.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: numerics.cpp:1130–1173 integrates full viscous traction as the viscous force split, not tangential skin friction; surface skin friction at :713 is tangential. Stress/heat and no-slip paths exist.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: driver.cpp:138–164 assembles BDF2/BDF1 full transient residual and :803–861 inner iterations; NaN ratio can evade miss count. Re200 fails by t=68.9; restart CLI is ignored.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and halo plans are source-evident; no rank-count evidence.

points.title: Output contract compliance

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit validator passes seven steady cases and correctly fails Re200 completed=false.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady packages exist but M2 laminar falsely marks early convergence while drag changes rapidly; Re200 fails at t=68.9/300 and rank comparison is absent.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Steady case force tails vary in quality; M2 laminar Cd falls 17.44% in final 3 steps, while Re200 Cd≈30 and run fails. Other steady evidence is case-specific.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: 11-page accepted report has four steady cases; separately delivered contestant figure manifest maps other case plots to data. Large startup spikes flatten late drag in laminar plots; no usable Re200 periodic plot.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report compiles and discloses M2 first order and Re200 failure, but report.tex:195–196,452–455 says Re200 failed at first step rather than actual t=68.9.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Report prose identifies result paths, but raw manifest was excluded from curated submission.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: 2→3. Final Cd 0.0007828649, Cl -0.000019957; last 10% Cd 0.000778673–0.000784053; 3.198/4 residual orders. Contestant-delivered residual, force and Mach zoom figures are mapped by solver/report/figure_manifest.csv; previous committed-only cap was too strict. Settled tail supports usable result, but target and grid convergence are not established.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: 4→3. Accepted report pp6–7 has numerical values and residual, force and Mach figures. Final Cd 0.008293034, Cl 0.001687321; last 10% Cd 0.008292737–0.008295459. Stable force tail but only 1.763/4 residual orders and no convergence study limit confidence.

naca0012_m200_inviscid.notes: 2→3. Original contestant-delivered residual, force and Mach zoom figures are mapped by solver/report/figure_manifest.csv; previous committed-only cap was too strict. Final Cd 0.09379655, last-10% Cd 0.0937913–0.0937966, residual reduction 3.015/3 orders. Report.tex:273–282 explicitly discloses first-order mode for M2; no second-order accuracy inference.

naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: 4→2. Accepted PDF p10 supplies force/residual and field figures, but large startup spike compresses late drag; final Cd 0.0751543, last-10% Cd 0.0751522–0.0751558, residual reduction 2.767/4 orders. A stable short tail does not establish boundary-layer convergence or a credible accuracy assessment.

naca0012_m080_laminar_re5000.notes: 4→2. Accepted PDF pp8–9 supplies force/residual and field figures, with late drag compressed by startup Cd about 22. Final Cd 0.0835947 at step 199, last-10% Cd 0.0835947–0.0844048 and Cl 0.00006415–0.0004458; residual reduction 4.008/4. Brief evolving history limits confidence despite nominal residual target.

naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2→1. Submitted results/naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000/{run_status.json,metadata.json} mark converged at step 33 with 3.005 residual-reduction orders; forces.csv Cd steps 30–33 is 0.25879026082, 0.24105224449, 0.22615804657, 0.21366941568, dropping 5.52% on the final step. A residual target was met, but such rapidly changing forces do not establish the clearly achieved early convergence needed by TASK.md:140 or the stable-force plateau in :172. This supports DQ7. M2 first-order operation is explicitly disclosed in report.tex:273–282,490. Original report figure provenance and remaining evaluation are under review.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: 4→3. Accepted PDF p11 supplies numerical, residual, force and Mach/pressure evidence. Final step 254 Cd 2.2478632, Cl -0.00025224; last-10% Cd 2.247863–2.247974 and residual reduction 5.003/5 orders. Force tail is stable and drag positive; short single-rank history and absence of convergence study limit accuracy confidence.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 0 retained. Designated case run_status and metadata explicitly say failed/completed=false at step 6889, t=68.9/300; original 6879 force rows remain grossly nonphysical (Cd≈36.68 at t=0.01, 40.22 at t=10, 29.98 at t=68.79) with no usable vortex-street result. Report.tex:195–196,452–455 says failure occurred at first step, conflicting with run_status and report manifest t=68.9. Metadata observed inner min/max 1000/1000 conflicts with residuals.csv containing many lower counts (including 5 and 10); recorded five misses/fraction 0.9993 and last ratio null cannot establish actual strict success count. Source driver.cpp:825–826,861 does not count NaN ratio as a miss because NaN comparison is false. No exact actual strict miss count is inferred, and failed status is not misrepresented as success.
